22908-T1 Final for Publication

SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
1527 West Edgewater Avenue
From RS-3 to RM-4.5

The Property

The property is improved with an underutilized religious assembly building. The surrounding area is comprised
of varying zoning districts, including RS-3, RT-4, RM-4.5, B2-3, B3-2, C1-2, and a Planned Development. The
area is improved with buildings comprised of residential and commercial uses; with a range of heights between 1
to 4 stories. The area is improved with buildings with heights ranging from 1 to 8 stories and comprised of single
and multi-residential, and commercial uses. The property is also a Transit Served Location per the Transit Oriented
Provisions of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, Section 17-10-0102-B(1), as it is within 210 feet of the Clark Street

Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segment.

The Project
The Applicant proposes to demolish the existing improvements and construct a three-story residential building

containing 4 dwelling units, 4 automobile parking spaces, and 4 bicycle parking spaces. No commercial space is
proposed. The proposed height of the building is 37.75 feet, with a height to the top of the stair enclosure of
49,58 feet. To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks a zoning change for the subject property
from an RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District to a RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District.
The Applicant is filing a Type | rezoning application and seeks all relief necessary and as allowed by
the Chicago Zoning Code for the proposed project, including: 1) a variation under § 17-13-1101-B to
decrease the front yard setback from 14.10 feet to 8.5 feet; 2) a variation under § 17-13-1101-B to
reduce the east side setback from the required 5.42 feet to 0 feet; 3) a variation under 17-13-1003-L
and 17-13-1101-A to increase the maximum height from 47.00 to 49.58 feet to accommodate the roof
enclosures; 4) to allow a variation pursuant to 17-13-1003-K and 17-13-1101-A to located the required
rear yard open space on a deck on the roof of the garage; and 5) a variation pursuant to 17-13-1101-B
to reduce the rear yard setback from 35.25 feet to zero to allow a rear deck that is more than four feet

above grade,

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 4,953 sq. ft.

Floor Area: 6,478 sq. ft.

FAR: 1.32

Residential Dwelling Units: 4

MLA Density: 1,238.75 sq. ft.

Height: 49.58 ft.

Automobile Parking: 4

Bicycle Parking: 4

Setbacks: Front (N. Edgewater) 8.50”
Side (West) 0.00”
Rear (South) 0.00’

Side (East) 0.00”
